summary.text: Darren Hamilton is the Libertarian candidate for Texas House District 57 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Richard Hayes and Democrat Ray Stith.
He is a U.S. Marine Corps veteran who works as an IT professional.

paragraphs.text: Hamilton was born in Spokane, Washington, served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 1984 to 1992 and earned a high school diploma from J.F. Dulles High School.
His professional experience includes information technology and data management, and he has also worked as an actor, radio personality, motivational speaker and club DJ.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Hamilton said he chairs the Denton County Libertarian Party and serves on the board of the St. Arbor Community Garden.
He said he ran for Congress in Texas' 24th District in 2020 and for Texas House District 57 in 2022 and 2024.
He named local control and limits on state preemption, civil liberties and privacy, and electoral reform as his main policy areas, and said his campaign is self-funded and accepts no donations.
